name: constructs
summary: Navigation and stationing for the constructs network: list/find/info/summary (source-of-truth ladder with provenance + drift), atlas/where (zones × topology × stationed loadouts), capabilities/robot-docs (self-describing contract), doctor. Mutations (install/station/observe) are integrity-verified and git-gated. Metacharacter-free: every operation is a single argv invocation, so it composes inside a Finn sandbox.

determinism.note: Ambient-free surfaces (--help, capabilities, robot-docs, caller-error paths) and every vector below are byte-deterministic and re-run identically. Live answers (list/find/info/atlas) carry `provenance` naming the source-of-truth rung instead of claiming byte-identity — a network answer cannot honestly promise stable bytes, so it promises stable PROVENANCE.

exit_codes.0: ok (an empty result is [] with exit 0, never an error)
exit_codes.1: tool failure — the CLI itself could not run
exit_codes.2: caller error — bad args, unknown verb, out-of-subset manifest
exit_codes.3: refused — outside your authority (foreign region, uncommitted stationing, unmounted region)
exit_codes.4: integrity mismatch — content hash, signature, or containment check failed
exit_codes.5: drift detected — source-of-truth rungs disagree; data IS emitted with provenance + drift[], and is refused as input to mutations unless --rung pins one source

vectors.name: help-usage (ambient-free: static help rendered from the verb table; no network, no clock, no filesystem outside cwd)
bare-invocation-is-triage-help-never-a-tui (Axiom 15: an agent that didn't expect a TUI would hang forever)
capabilities-json (ambient-free: the contract as data, generated from the verb table)
caller-error-unknown-verb (exit 2; stdout stays empty — diagnostics belong on stderr)
mutation-typo-is-refused-not-inferred (exit 2: a write you only approximately asked for is never performed)
